add.k: Head of a Chinatown Triad that deals heroin
st: Yang's men try to seize Joy over the pier, but he joins Danny's raid on the Hand's warehouse and later warns Ward about the Hand.
Yang agrees to run heroin through Harlem with Mariah, then baits Bushmaster with it and flees when Luke Cage steps in.
Yang refuses Danny's plea for peace, then backs out of his deal with Davos, who gives him a stroke he does not survive.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'I am Yang Hai-Qing, head of the Yangshi Gongsi' (IF S1 e4), 'Hai-Qing Yang' (IF S1 e7). Group: he names it the Yangsi Gonshi himself (subtitles spell it 'Yangshi Gongsi' in IF S1, 'Yangsi Gonshi' in LC S2); IF S2 dialogue calls the same Triad 'the Hatchets' / 'the Hatchet Triad', so either name is on screen. Davos gives him the stroke in IF S2 e2; he is last on screen bedridden in e4; his death is first made clear by Sherry in e6 ('As my husband used to say') and stated in e8 ('he killed my husband'), so the IF S2 step's ep is 6.

add.k: Danny's mother and Wendell Rand's wife
st: Heather comforts young Danny on the family jet as it breaks apart over the Himalayas, and she is pulled out to her death.

files.notes: Named on screen: Wendell shouts 'Heather' on the jet and a news report says 'Wendell Rand, his wife Heather and their son, Danny' (e1). Seen only in Danny's memories of the crash (e1, e2, e13). No job or group shown: Independent.

add.k: Owner of the Silver Lotus restaurant in Chinatown
st: Colleen saves Henry from Ryhno's crew and he admits Frank Choi is his cousin, but he refuses Davos's protection and Davos kills him.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'Silver Lotus. Name's Yip. Henry Yip.' (e1); Davos: 'Your name is Henry Yip?' (e8). Group is his own restaurant, the Silver Lotus, named in dialogue (e1).

add.k: A reporter for the New York Bulletin
st: Jennifer asks Danny about his stay at Birch in front of the press, then interviews Ward and writes Danny up as a corporate hero.

files.notes: Named on screen: she introduces herself 'Jennifer Many, New York Bulletin' (e4) and Ward says 'Contact that reporter, Jennifer Many.' Only on screen in IF S1 e4 (mentioned in Daredevil S3). Article title 'Daniel Rand, Corporate Hero' per wiki (IF104).

n: A thug in the records room
k: A thug who burns Danny's hospital records
st: Singleton burns Danny's hospital records, helps Harold stage Wilkins's murder as a suicide, and is shot dead by Bakuto's men.

files.notes: Unnamed in e3 (the records fight). Harold calls him 'Singleton' (e10, e11) and 'Kevin' (e12), so the full name is staged at e12. He works for Harold personally; no organization is named on screen: Independent.

st: Kyle keeps Harold's secret and traces Danny's call to Colleen, until the risen Harold beats him to death with an ice cream scoop.

files.notes: Named on screen by Harold ('Will you ever betray me, Kyle?', e1). Works for Harold personally, not shown as Rand staff: Independent.

add.k: A senior board member at Rand Enterprises
st: Wilkins fights Danny's choices on the board and fires the Meachums, until Harold shoots him and stages it as a suicide.

files.notes: Unnamed at the e4 board meeting; Ward calls him 'Lawrence' (e5), Joy names 'Wilkins's recommendation' (e6), full name in e10. Raft as the boardroom foe who works against Danny; could be argued as Compound (a victim of Harold). The Jessica Jones lead on his arrest is left out (she is only heard on the phone).

st: Liu throws Danny out of the Yang home, then hides Sherry from Davos and dies fighting him so the civilians can escape.

files.notes: Named on screen by Sherry ('Liu, stand down.', e4). Group as for Hai-Qing Yang (Yangsi Gonshi, called the Hatchets in IF S2 dialogue).

st: Megan calls security on the returning Danny, then becomes his assistant and tracks down two of the Hand's warehouses.

files.notes: First named aloud in e4 ('just check with our assistant Megan'); before that only a speaker tag in subtitles. Her later brief scenes (e7 helping Danny dress, e13 meeting Harold) are left out of the sentence.

add.k: Joy's old college rival at an auction house
st: Joy and Davos blackmail Mika with a secret recording into handing over the Erskine bowl, and she later explains it to Misty.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'Isn't that Mika Prada?' (e2), Joy to Misty 'Her name is Mika Prada. Bailey's Auction House.' (e7). Group from that line and her showing the Erskine collection at the Bailey's event; that she works there is inferred from dialogue, not stated outright.

add.k: A psychiatrist at Birch Psychiatric Hospital
st: Edmonds comes to believe Danny really is Danny Rand but calls the Iron Fist a delusion, and later commits Ward to Birch.
Mary Walker asks Edmonds about her escape in Sokovia, then walks out when he suggests months of treatment.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'Paul Edmonds from the Birch Psychiatric Hospital' (IF S1 e2), and 'Edmonds' in IF S2 e8. On screen IF S1 e2 and e9, IF S2 e8.

add.k: A chemist the Hand forces to make its heroin
st: Danny frees the Hand's chemist Radovan, who begs him to save his daughter Sabina, but the Hand takes him back and kills him.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'Radovan, the chemist.' (e5) and Sabina named by him; the surname Bernivig is not in the dialogue, so n is 'Radovan'. Group: forced to make the Hand's heroin (forced service counts); freed and recaptured, so kept as The Hand.

add.k: Owner of the pier Rand Enterprises wants
st: Raj refuses to sell his pier until the Meachums offer a dying donor's liver for his nephew Terence, and he gives in.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'The pier deal and Raj Patel.' (e3). Owns the pier; no company is named on screen: Independent.

add.k: Leader of a Chinatown street gang
st: Ryhno shakes down Henry Yip and holds Danny for ransom, then follows Davos until one of his own crew kills him for trying to quit.

files.notes: First on screen e1 unnamed; 'Who's Ryhno?' (e2). Killed in e8 by Crank (named only in e9) on Davos's word, so the sentence does not name his killer.

add.k: A worker at Bayard Community Center
st: Sam helps Colleen hunt for Frank Choi, hides Sherry Yang at Bayard, finds the sedative used on Davos and agrees to a service for BB.

files.notes: Named on screen as 'Sam' (e2 'I'm meeting Sam at noon', e9 'Thanks, Sam.'); the surname Chung is not in the dialogue, so n is 'Sam'.

st: Sandi tests the new heroin for Danny, then quietly helps him, now barred from the building, take chemicals from the vault.

files.notes: Named on screen: 'Thank you so much for your help, Sandi.' (e5); the surname Ann is not in the dialogue, so n is 'Sandi'.

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Danny warns Yang that the Hand forced Rand Enterprises to take his pier. He returns with Colleen to rally Yang against Madame Gao, and Yang's men join the raid on the Hand's warehouse.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist who rallies him against the Hand
stages.whoB: The Triad boss he teams with against the Hand

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Danny urges Yang to make peace with the Golden Tigers and smashes his desk when Yang insists on blood for blood. After Davos strikes him down, Yang uses his last strength to tell Danny where Davos's cargo is coming in.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist who pushes him to make peace
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who gives him Davos's secret

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Colleen comes with Danny to win Yang and his men over against Madame Gao. She fights beside them in the raid on the Hand's warehouse.
stages.whoA: Danny's partner in the raid on the Hand
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who joins their raid

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen helps talk Sherry Yang into pushing her husband toward peace. She and Danny visit the bedridden Yang, who whispers the clue about Davos's cargo before Sherry throws them out.
stages.whoA: The sensei who helps push him toward peace
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who whispers Davos's secret

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah offers Yang a deal to run his heroin through Harlem, and they shake on it though it breaks her family's old rule. He backs her before the other crime bosses and helps her bait Bushmaster.
stages.whoA: The Harlem boss who opens Harlem to his heroin
stages.whoB: The Chinatown heroin boss she partners with

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Yang sells heroin under Bushmaster's name to draw him out. Bushmaster storms the warehouse to confront him, and Yang slips away as his men open fire.
stages.whoA: The man he baits with heroin in his name
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who puts poison out in his name

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: When Yang's men open fire on Bushmaster at the warehouse, Luke shields him. Luke and Bushmaster beat Yang's crew while Yang escapes.
stages.whoA: The bulletproof man who wrecks his trap
stages.whoB: The Triad boss whose crew he fights

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos pays Yang to bring a shipment through his docks and kills two of his men when Yang raises the price. When Yang backs out to make peace with the Tigers, Davos embraces him and leaves him struck down by a stroke.
stages.whoA: The client who strikes him down
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who goes back on his word

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward comes to Yang asking what he knows about the Hand and tells him to name his price. Yang refuses money, tells him the tale of a man the Hand kept bringing back, and warns him his only way out is to run.
stages.whoA: Harold Meachum's son, who comes to him for answers on the Hand
stages.whoB: The Triad boss who warns him about the Hand

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Heather comes home with Wendell to find young Danny bullied over a board game by Ward. On the family jet she leaves her seat to hold Danny and tell him she loves him, moments before she is pulled from the plane.
stages.whoA: Her son
stages.whoB: His mother, lost in the crash

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Heather and Wendell come home together to Danny and the Meachum children. On the jet Wendell begs her to stay in her seat as the plane breaks apart, and he loses her.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen drives a street gang away from Henry outside his restaurant, then beats them when they come back to threaten his staff. Grateful, Henry admits that Frank Choi is his cousin.
stages.whoA: The sensei who saves his restaurant
stages.whoB: The restaurant owner she saves from a gang

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Ryhno's crew tries to shake Henry down for protection money and threatens his staff until Colleen stops them. Later Ryhno comes back at Davos's side to apologize, and watches Davos kill him.
stages.whoA: The restaurant owner he shakes down
stages.whoB: The gang leader who extorts him

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos brings Ryhno's crew to apologize to Henry and offers him free protection. When Henry says he wants no part of any side, Davos calls him a Tiger and kills him.
stages.whoA: The man who kills him for staying neutral
stages.whoB: The restaurant owner he kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward has Jennifer brought in for a private interview and rants over bourbon about Danny selling the new cure at cost. She leaves with the story Ward wanted told.
stages.whoA: The Rand CEO who feeds her a story
stages.whoB: The Bulletin reporter he uses for good press

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: At Danny's welcome press conference Jennifer asks if he was committed to Birch, and he admits it. Her story then praises him as a corporate hero.
stages.whoA: The heir she questions, then praises in print
stages.whoB: The reporter who asks about Birch

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Singleton works as Harold's enforcer, cutting phone lines and cleaning up after his crimes. He stands guard at Harold's penthouse until Bakuto's men burst in.
stages.whoA: The boss he cleans up after
stages.whoB: His enforcer

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: A thug knocks Danny down in the hospital records room, and they fight while the files go up in flames. He gets away while Danny pulls a woman from the fire.
stages.whoA: The heir whose records he burns
stages.whoB: The man who burns his hospital records

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Singleton cuts Wilkins's phone line and guards the door while Harold confronts him. After Harold shoots Wilkins, Singleton makes it look like a suicide.
stages.whoA: The board member whose murder he covers up
stages.whoB: Harold's man who stages his suicide

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Bakuto's men storm Harold's penthouse. They shoot Singleton before he can fire.
stages.whoA: The leader whose men gun him down
stages.whoB: Harold's enforcer, shot by his men

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Kyle keeps Harold's secret and runs his errands, from tracing Danny's call to Colleen to picking Harold up after his return. Harold then beats him to death with an ice cream scoop.
stages.whoA: The secret boss who kills him
stages.whoB: His loyal assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward finds Kyle working at Harold's side and asks if his father overworks him. Kyle later calls Ward to the penthouse for Harold.
stages.whoA: Harold's son
stages.whoB: His father's assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wilkins fights Danny's plans to sell the new cure at cost and to shut the chemical plant. He tells Danny the board will not follow a child who knows nothing of business.
stages.whoA: The heir who upends his board
stages.whoB: The board member who fights him

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wilkins hands Joy and Ward a termination deal. Joy turns it down and vows to take the company back, and he kills the deal.
stages.whoA: The executive he forces out
stages.whoB: The board member who fires her

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Wilkins fires Ward along with Joy. When Ward comes back pleading for a separate severance, Wilkins refuses and says Harold would be ashamed.
stages.whoA: The CEO he fires
stages.whoB: The board member who fires him

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Harold waits in Wilkins's office with proof of his embezzling and tells him to kill himself to spare his son. When Wilkins refuses, Harold shoots him.
stages.whoA: His old partner, back from the dead to kill him
stages.whoB: The board member he kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Liu guards the bedridden Yang at his home after the stroke. He drags Danny out when the visit makes Yang's heart race.
stages.whoA: The Triad boss he guards
stages.whoB: One of the men guarding his home

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Liu mocks Danny and throws him out of the Yang home, but later lets Danny and Colleen lead Sherry out ahead of Davos. At Bayard Liu wants to fight Davos while Danny begs them to wait.
stages.whoA: The Iron Fist he first throws out
stages.whoB: Sherry Yang's security chief

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen calms Liu at the Yang home, then fights off an attacker in the street so Liu can get the car and drive Sherry away. At Bayard she persuades him to lead the civilians out.
stages.whoA: The sensei who helps him save Sherry
stages.whoB: Sherry Yang's security chief

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: As Davos hunts the Triad leaders, Liu hides Sherry from him. When Davos reaches Bayard, Liu faces him with his hatchets to cover the escape, and Davos kills him.
stages.whoA: The man he dies fighting
stages.whoB: The Triad guard he kills

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Sam hides Liu and Sherry at Bayard and lets the Triads meet there, though he fears for the families upstairs. Liu insists the families are safer with the Triads around.
stages.whoA: The Bayard worker who hides them
stages.whoB: The Triad guard he lets hide at Bayard

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Megan calls security when a ragged Danny walks in claiming to be Danny Rand, then becomes his assistant once he is back. She finds two of the Hand's warehouses for him, and he asks her to call him Danny.
stages.whoA: The boss she once called security on
stages.whoB: His assistant at Rand

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy has her assistant help her study old photos of Danny and ship him a box of candy. The assistant later shows Colleen into Joy's office.
stages.whoA: Her boss at Rand
stages.whoB: Her assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward has Megan set up his interview with the reporter Jennifer Many. Later he shouts at her over his emptied trash can.
stages.whoA: Her short-tempered boss
stages.whoB: His assistant

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Joy runs into her old college rival Mika at Bailey's Auction House and wins her over with drinks. Joy secretly records Mika with Davos and uses it to take the Erskine bowl, then sends Misty to her.
stages.whoA: Her college rival who blackmails her
stages.whoB: Her old college rival

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mika sleeps with Davos at Joy's apartment, and he turns rough with her. Joy's recording of it becomes the blackmail that costs Mika the bowl.
stages.whoA: The man Joy uses to trap her
stages.whoB: The woman Joy uses him to blackmail

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty asks Mika about the bowl Joy took from her. Mika shows her a painting with instructions for the ritual the bowl belongs to.
stages.whoA: The detective she helps
stages.whoB: The art expert who explains the bowl

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Edmonds treats Danny as a man named John Anderson until his own checks prove Danny's story. He still calls the Iron Fist a trauma delusion and wants to keep Danny for his safety.
stages.whoA: The patient whose story proves true
stages.whoB: His psychiatrist at Birch

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: After police find heroin in Ward's car, Edmonds hears him claim his dead father set him up. Edmonds commits him to Birch as an addict.
stages.whoA: The CEO he commits to Birch
stages.whoB: The psychiatrist who commits him

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Walker asks Edmonds who could have killed her captors in Sokovia, and he suggests a third alter. She walks out when he proposes months of treatment.
stages.whoA: A soldier with DID looking for answers
stages.whoB: The psychiatrist she consults

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Danny breaks Radovan out of the Hand's truck and promises to rescue his daughter Sabina. When Danny finds him again the Hand has stabbed him, and he dies before Danny's eyes.
stages.whoA: The man who frees him from the Hand
stages.whoB: The Hand's chemist he frees

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Colleen drives the getaway car and brings the wounded Radovan to her dojo, where she keeps him talking through the pain. She is with Danny when they find him dying.
stages.whoA: The sensei who shelters him
stages.whoB: The chemist she shelters

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire treats Radovan's wound at the dojo while he refuses any hospital. When he collapses she takes him to one, and the Hand snatches him there.
stages.whoA: The nurse who treats him
stages.whoB: The chemist she treats

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Gao's Hand holds Radovan's daughter to force him to make its heroin. Once the Hand has him back, Gao gets his formula and he is left to bleed out.
stages.whoA: The Hand leader who forces his work
stages.whoB: Her captive chemist

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Joy courts Raj over dinner after he turns down Rand's offers for his pier. She takes him to a hospital where a dying donor's liver could go to his nephew Terence, and Raj agrees to sell.
stages.whoA: The executive who buys his pier
stages.whoB: The pier owner she wins over

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Ward joins Joy's evening with Raj, which ends at the hospital bed that makes Raj sell the pier.
stages.whoA: The CEO who wants his pier
stages.whoB: The pier owner he pressures

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Colleen drives Ryhno's crew away from Henry Yip's restaurant, then follows BB to their hideout and talks her way out. She later comes with Misty to free Danny from him.
stages.whoA: The sensei who keeps stopping him
stages.whoB: The gang leader she keeps stopping

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Ryhno's crew find the injured Danny and hold him for ransom, and Ryhno threatens to cut off his finger. He gives Danny up when Misty fires a warning shot.
stages.whoA: The man he holds for ransom
stages.whoB: The gang leader who holds him for ransom

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty fires a warning shot at Ryhno's hideout, and he hands Danny over while mouthing off to her.
stages.whoA: The detective who makes him give up Danny
stages.whoB: The gang leader she faces down

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Davos humbles Ryhno's crew and offers to train them, and Ryhno brings them to him and calls him Shifu. After Davos kills Henry Yip, Ryhno tries to quit and is killed on Davos's word.
stages.whoA: The Shifu he follows, then tries to leave
stages.whoB: The gang leader he takes under his command

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Ryhno sends BB after Colleen and threatens to deal with him when he fails. BB still follows him into Davos's training.
stages.whoA: A kid in his crew
stages.whoB: The leader of his crew

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Sam helps Colleen look for Frank Choi and hides Sherry Yang at Bayard for her. When the Triads plan to fight Davos there he calls Colleen, and afterward they plan a service for BB.
stages.whoA: His friend and Bayard volunteer
stages.whoB: Her friend at Bayard Community Center

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Sam finds the drugs Danny needs to sedate Davos and lends him the center's van.
stages.whoA: Colleen's partner against Davos
stages.whoB: The Bayard worker who helps stop Davos

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Sandi tests the new heroin for Danny and warns it could cause an epidemic. When he is barred from the building, she helps him take chemicals from the vault without asking why.
stages.whoA: The boss she keeps helping
stages.whoB: A Rand chemist he trusts

dropped.why: Never named on screen: in the IF S2 e5 transcript she appears only as a subtitle speaker tag '[Priya.]'; Davos calls her 'Mother' and no one says or shows 'Priya' (the wiki gives no citation for the name). Credits only.

Never named on screen: in IF S1 e5 her name appears only as subtitle speaker tags '[Regina.]'; she is never addressed or named in dialogue (the board meeting and news report do not name her) and no source shows a caption. Credits only.

changes.why: The step ends with the stroke he does not survive. Davos gives the stroke in e2 (not e4 as the notes said); e4 shows him still alive in bed, and his death is first made clear in e6 when Sherry says 'As my husband used to say' (stated outright in e8). Keying to e4 would spoil his death.

changes.where: tie Hai-Qing Yang|Davos, Iron Fist S2 ep
changes.why: The last event in the stage (Davos embraces Yang and leaves him struck by the stroke) is in e2; Davos and Yang share no scene after that.

changes.where: tie Megan|Joy Meachum, Iron Fist S1 text
changes.was: Joy has Megan help her study old photos of Danny and ship him a box of candy. Megan later shows Colleen into Joy's office.
changes.now: Joy has her assistant help her study old photos of Danny and ship him a box of candy. The assistant later shows Colleen into Joy's office.
changes.why: The stage is keyed to e2, but the name Megan is first said in e4 ('just check with our assistant Megan'); in e2 it is only a subtitle speaker tag. Names only once said.

changes.now: Hai-Qing Yang|Ward Meachum, ally, Iron Fist S1, ep 9
changes.why: Yang's own IF S1 step says he warns Ward about the Hand; they share a full scene in e9 ('Danny Rand told me that you've had experience with the Hand... Name your price' ... 'The only solution is to run').
